subject: PLATFORM: 49 other dispatch windows-boxes have the same dir/cd gap as NT1 (fixed in 373)
description:
Found by Nancy during the NT1 fix 2026-09-09. Of 51 boxes with promptStyle: 'windows', ZERO of the 50 dispatch boxes override 'cd'. So 'cd' falls through to Terminal.js's POSIX builtin (Terminal.js:310 -> _cmdCd, error at :628), which walks each box's declared 'filesystem'. Where that filesystem is empty or POSIX-shaped, a student in a Windows CMD sim gets the bash error 'cd: <target>: No such file or directory'. Several of those boxes also hardcode 'dir' output, so they advertise directories 'cd' cannot enter -- the exact defect the operator hit on NT1 HD-7201. ls/cat/pwd/head/tail/man/uname/file/history are likewise reachable Terminal.js builtins and answer with Linux-flavoured output. DO NOT fix by editing Terminal.js: two boxes (mail001-queue-backup, mail002-email-auth) are genuine promptStyle 'linux' sims that deliberately reject cls with bash errors, so a blind engine-level change breaks intentional design. Pattern to copy: _app/dispatch/boxes/nt1-network-troubleshoot/config.js (_fileTree + _resolveWinPath + box-local dir/cd/type/find + Linux-command blocks). Harness to copy/extend: _tools/hexos/nt1-filesystem-commands.test.js (proven to fail before it passed; supports NT1_REPO_ROOT for a baseline arm).
[2026-09-09 19:16] Subject self-reference is wrong: the NT1 fix is NOT task 373 (that is this task). NT1 was fixed directly on master 2026-09-09, no task id. Read the subject as 'same gap as NT1, which is already fixed'.
[2026-09-09 21:57] TRUE SCALE, measured 2026-09-09 by _tools/hexos/box-contract-lint.js once its coverage was fixed: SHELL-001 (Windows box overrides dir but not cd) fires on 26 boxes, SHELL-002 (dir advertises directories nothing can enter) on 12. The earlier '49 dispatch windows-boxes' estimate came from a scan that could not parse 105 of 293 configs -- it matched only 'const <X>Config = {' while boxes also use 'var' (84) and 'window.' (20), and an unparsed config yields no findings, which looks exactly like a clean one. Coverage is now 292/293 configs (d18-corrupted-oracle has a TDZ in its own source). All 26+12 are recorded in _tools/reports/BOX_CONTRACT_BASELINE.json, so the gate blocks a NEW occurrence while this backlog is worked. Fix pattern: _app/dispatch/boxes/nt1-network-troubleshoot/config.js (_fileTree + _resolveWinPath + box-local dir/cd/type/find). DO NOT fix by editing Terminal.js -- mail001-queue-backup and mail002-email-auth are genuine promptStyle 'linux' sims.
